title: 第9章 并非骑士第10章 逃离吧千金
slug: 骑士先生魔王真的不存在啊
lines: 第9章并非骑士
姆莉尴尬地看向骑士，却在阴影笼罩下感受到强大的压迫感，一时不敢多言……好吓人……
“这是经过镇长确定的最终结果，唐。”骑士团的团长没有在意姆莉，只是平静的看着唐。
“如此实属不公，欧吉桑先生在不知情的情况下被恶人利用，是无心之举。”唐严肃地看着骑士团团长，没有半分退让的意思。
“骑士团寻人一月有余，但我借用欧吉桑先生的猎犬却能找到被绑架掳走的人，欧吉桑先生非但无过，并且有功，不该罚他。”
“唐！”骑士团的团长突然大喝一声，吓得姆莉身子一哆嗦，紧张地吞咽了一口唾沫。
“你知道自己在说什么吗？”他气愤地瞪着唐。
唐的发言无异于辱骂骑士团，说骑士团无能，甚至不如一条狗。
“我说，欧吉桑先生有功无过，骑士团不该罚他。”唐骄傲地挺起了胸膛。
“若骑士团一意要罚，那我便向骑士团发起决斗。”
姆莉被唐吓得睁大了眼，一时间不知该如何是好。
普通人怎么跟骑士团斗？唐这是疯了！哦对，唐早就疯了，他一直都是疯的，只是表现得很正常。
“唐，没有任何一位骑士会与你决斗。”骑士团的团长注视着唐，“你并不是一位骑士，认清现实，唐，自称的骑士并不是真正的骑士。”
说罢，团长走过唐的身边，不再搭理他。
至于那位训狗人——欧吉桑，他还是被骑士没收了近期从人贩手中赚到的钱，并交了一笔罚款。
周围群众看着唐与骑士团，明显是向着唐的，想要出声表达对唐的支持，却碍于其他原因不敢开口，估计与姆莉有着完全一样的担忧。
唐就这么直勾勾地盯着骑士团，平静的目光下似乎潜藏着惊人的愤怒。姆莉只是看了一眼唐，就有种被吓到的感觉。
看了眼唐那双握紧的拳头，姆莉本能皱眉，思考自己接下来应当向唐说些什么才好。
可就在这时，人群中的一道小巧身影突然跑出，吸引了众人的视线。
“店长你怎么会是坏人，怎么可以是坏人？！”说话的是个女孩，看年龄应当还不到两位数。
她手上捧着一束漂亮的鲜花，看向被关在木笼里的莫扎利亚，露出了如同遭人背叛那般被刺痛内心的表情。
看了少女一眼，莫扎利亚忽然转头仰望天空。
“我喜欢站在阳光下，因为大多数花卉只在阳光下盛开，若不得已，我也不会投身于黑夜。”
他的话在大多数人听来有种不知所谓的意思，可落在感性的少女耳中却有了诗情画意的解释。
某位骑士在听到莫扎利亚的话语后突然露出了惊恐的目光，随后放轻了脚步，悄悄离开了现场。
而这位骑士也是昨日与莫扎利亚有过神情互动的骑士，三番两次有异常之举，绝对有问题。
唐快速扫了一眼，记下了对方的容貌。
突然一声响动吓到了莫扎利亚，原来是有一名骑士踢了一脚木笼。
那骑士不满道：“讲什么谜语？不过是利欲熏心的卑劣小人。”
这一句话直接粉碎了某些少女心中最后的期望，再没人对莫扎利亚抱有不切实际的幻想。
不一会儿，这伙人贩就被押送离开了。
在骑士们离开前，与唐比较相熟的曼波小跑而来，在唐的肩膀上拍了两下：“唐，团长要我提醒你一些事。”

Chapter 9 Not a Knight
Muli looked at the knight awkwardly, but felt a strong sense of oppression under the shadow. She didn't dare to say anything for a moment...it was so scary...
"This is the final result determined by the mayor, Tang." The leader of the knights did not pay attention to Mu Li, but looked at Tang calmly.
"This is really unfair. Mr. Ogissan was taken advantage of by evil people without knowing it. It was an unintentional act." Tang looked at the leader of the knights seriously, without any intention of giving in.
"The Knights have been searching for the person for more than a month, but I borrowed Mr. Ogisan's hunting dog and was able to find the kidnapped person. Not only did Mr. Ogisan have no fault, but he also made merit. He should not be punished."
"Don!" The leader of the knights suddenly shouted, which made Mu Li tremble and swallow nervously.
"Do you know what you're talking about?" He glared at Don angrily.
Don's speech was tantamount to insulting the Knights, saying that the Knights were incompetent and even worse than a dog.
"I say that Mr. Ogisan has merit and fault, and the Knights should not punish him." Tang puffed up his chest proudly.
"If the Knights insist on punishment, then I will challenge the Knights to a duel."
Mu Li was so frightened by Tang that her eyes widened and she didn't know what to do for a moment.
How can ordinary people fight against the Knights? Don is crazy! Oh yeah, Don was crazy a long time ago, he's always been crazy, he just acted normal.
"Don, no knight will duel with you." The leader of the knights looked at Tang, "You are not a knight. Recognize the reality. Don, the knight who claims to be is not a real knight."
After that, the group leader walked past Tang and ignored him.
As for the dog trainer, Ogissan, the knight confiscated the money he had recently earned from human traffickers and paid a fine.
The people around looked at Tang and the Knights, obviously towards Tang. They wanted to express their support for Tang, but they did not dare to speak out due to other reasons. They probably had the same worries as Muli.
Tang just stared straight at the knights, and there seemed to be shocking anger hidden under his calm eyes. Mu Li just glanced at Tang and felt frightened.
Looking at Tang's clenched fists, Muli frowned instinctively, thinking about what she should say to Tang next.
But at this moment, a small figure suddenly ran out from the crowd, attracting everyone's attention.
"Store manager, how can you be a bad person? How can you be a bad person?!" The person who spoke was a girl, whose age should be less than two digits.
She held a beautiful bouquet of flowers in her hands and looked at Mozalia who was locked in a wooden cage, showing an expression that hurt her heart as if she had been betrayed.
After glancing at the girl, Mozalia suddenly turned her head and looked up at the sky.
"I like to stand in the sun because most flowers only bloom in the sun, and I won't throw myself into the night if I have to."
His words sounded meaningless to most people, but to the ears of a sensitive girl, they had a poetic interpretation.
After hearing Mozalia's words, a certain knight suddenly showed a horrified look, then stepped lightly and quietly left the scene.
And this knight was also the knight who had an emotional interaction with Mozalia yesterday. He behaved strangely again and again, so there was definitely something wrong.
Tang glanced quickly and took note of the other person's appearance.
"Clang-"
A sudden noise startled Mozalia. It turned out that a knight kicked the wooden cage.
The knight said dissatisfied: "What riddles are you talking about? He is just a despicable villain who is obsessed with profit."
This sentence directly shattered the last expectations in the hearts of some girls, and no one had unrealistic illusions about Mozalia.
After a while, the traffickers were escorted away.
Before the knights left, Mambo, who was relatively familiar with Tang, trotted over and patted Tang on the shoulder twice: "Tang, the leader wants me to remind you of something."
